items.title: 66100_Bud Freeman oral history interview
items.q: A drummer by the name of Bobby Orr -- well, as I mentioned Bruce Turner, oh, yes, Roy Williams, who is a very fine trombone player.

ctx.x: Oh, very much so. We made an album called The Song of the Tenor and Bruce is on that. The recording company Phonogram asked me if I'd like to do an album and what would I like to use, and I said, I would like to do an all British album, use all British musicians who are exploited too much, and Bob Wilber happened to be here and so we used Bob and it was a fine album, with Bruce, Bob and I on reeds, and a young London pianist by the name of Keith Ingam, plays very well, and he's going to the States by the way, to…
